Day 2 can be dedicated to visiting the nearby Völklingen Ironworks, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Day 3 can be a day trip to the nearby French border, where you can visit the picturesque town of Forbach and enjoy the scenic views of the Saar River. For activities, I recommend visiting the Saarbrücken Botanical Garden on Day 1, which is a peaceful oasis in the heart of the city.
